tables.name: District Type
tables.description: Rolled for each district a priority or leadership did not give. Multiples are allowed.

results.name: Administration
results.description: This district has a focus on government and civil matters.

results.name: Arcane
results.description: This district has a focus on magical matters.

results.name: Botanical
results.description: This district has a focus on nature.

results.name: Craft
results.description: This district has a focus on the creation of different goods.

results.name: Docks
results.description: This district has a focus on all naval and seafaring matters. (Rerolled unless the city is Coastal or River.)

results.name: Industrial
results.description: This district has a focus on large-scale production facilities.

results.name: Market
results.description: This district has a focus on the sale of practical goods.

results.name: Merchant
results.description: This district has a focus on business and non-essential goods.

results.name: Scholar
results.description: This district has a focus on education and the pursuit of knowledge.

results.name: Slums
results.description: This district is an area where those with lesser means might live. (Roll a d4 on district condition) (-1 to quality rolls for locations in this district)

results.name: Temple
results.description: This district has a focus on religion and/or spiritual enlightenment.

results.name: Upper Class
results.description: This district is an area where those with greater means might live. (+3 to its district condition roll) (+3 to quality rolls for locations in this district)
